experiment: G4 image-token pruning (FastV-style) on the 32B escalation forward
verdict: NOT quick to wire -> feasibility + concrete implementation plan reported; the -26% FLOP projection STANDS (labeled projection, grounded by measured image-token fractions). No 32B pruning forward was run (disciplined: correct wiring is multi-hour + a wrong impl would fabricate a lesion-safety accuracy number).

measured_grounding.note: REAL numbers (offline, from ckpts/token_cache.json processor counts + existing repo artifacts).
measured_grounding.prefill_is_image_dominated: escalation-heavy cells: VQA-RAD 0.918, SLAKE 0.844, PathVQA 0.895, PMC 0.852, MedXpert 0.68-0.80 -> the 32B short-answer forward IS prefill/image-token bound, the premise the projection rests on.

resolution_cap_analog_lesion_safety.what: cap320 vs full-res closed subsets (UNIFIED_METHOD_EXPERIMENTS.md L616-617) = encoder-side image-token REDUCTION, the measured analog of pruning.
resolution_cap_analog_lesion_safety.implication: cutting image information is FREE on PMC/pathology but COSTS on RADIOLOGY (SLAKE -0.017, VQA-RAD -0.040). So a 50% image-token prune on the escalation-heavy radiology cells carries REAL accuracy risk -> per-benchmark guardrail mandatory. FastV attention-guidance (keep salient tokens) is the hoped-for mitigation over uniform resolution-cap, but is UNVALIDATED for medical fine detail.

projection_unchanged.claim: prune 50% of the 32B image tokens after a shallow LLM layer -> forward FLOP-eq 4.57 -> ~3.37 (-26%), latency ~-26% of the prefill-bound 665 ms no-think forward.
projection_unchanged.consistency_check: With image tokens ~85-92% of the sequence and MLP-dominated (hidden 5120, 64 layers) ~linear-in-tokens compute, dropping 0.5*0.9*N tokens after a shallow layer K~=3 gives LLM-transformer FLOP ratio ~[K+(L-K)*0.575]/L ~= 0.60 on the LLM stack; the unpruned vision encoder dilutes this toward the quoted -26% on the full 4.57 forward. Order-of-magnitude consistent; NOT independently re-measured.

why_not_quick: Production 32B inference in this repo is vLLM (verifier_32b_gpu.py, run_32b_vllm.py: LLM(..., tensor_parallel_size=tp)). vLLM's paged KV-cache + CUDA-graph capture do NOT support mid-network per-layer token dropping without a custom model plugin -> the deployable latency claim needs a vLLM surgery, not a flag.

Model is Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration (64 layers, hidden 5120) which uses M-RoPE: 3D (temporal,height,width) position ids derived from the image grid. FastV was designed for 1D-RoPE LLaVA; pruning image tokens mid-network requires correctly RE-INDEXING the 3D position ids of the retained tokens -> not a drop-in.
Vision-token span is dynamic (spatial-merge, variable image size, delimited by <|vision_start|>/<|vision_end|>) -> must be located per-sample.
Ranking tokens by attention needs attn_implementation='eager' (flash/sdpa don't return weights) -> slow + memory-heavy at 32B; KV cache must be pruned consistently for the subsequent decode steps.

A MEDICAL LESION-SAFETY accuracy claim (the point of Exp 2) requires a validated implementation; a half-correct one would produce a MISLEADING accuracy number (violates the no-fabricated-numbers rule).

path_A_HF_smoke_recommended_first: Locate image-token positions from input_ids via <|vision_start|>..<|vision_end|> (or the image-pad id).
Register a forward hook after decoder layer K (sweep K in {2,3,5}): read mean attention from the final text token(s) to image positions; keep top-r image tokens (r=0.5), drop the rest.
On drop: slice hidden_states, REBUILD the M-RoPE position_ids for retained tokens, shrink the causal mask; continue layers K+1..64 and generate (max_new_tokens small, greedy).
PARITY GATE: r=1.0 (no prune) MUST reproduce the full-token accuracy exactly (idx-level) before trusting any r<1 number.

Scope: ~200/benchmark on VQA-RAD-closed, SLAKE, MedXpert (escalation-heavy); r in {1.0, 0.5}; measure acc vs full-token + per-benchmark guardrail (no cell below always-7B). SHORT tp=2 runs, timeout -s KILL 1800, <=2 retries.
implementation_plan.path_A_variant_7B_attention_guided: the backlog's G4 novelty (reuse the 7B cheap-leg cross-attention to pick which tokens the 32B keeps) adds 7B<->32B image-grid alignment (different resolution/merge) -> defer; smoke the 32B-own-attention FastV first.
implementation_plan.path_B_vLLM_production_for_latency_claim: implement a custom Qwen2_5_VL vLLM model with a prune op after layer K (or a plugin) -> larger effort; needed only to convert the FLOP projection into a measured batch-1 latency win.
implementation_plan.estimated_effort: Path A smoke: several hours incl. M-RoPE re-indexing + parity validation. Path B: 1-2 days. Neither is 'quick'.

recommendation: Given the measured resolution-cap analog already shows image-token reduction is domain-selective (FREE on PMC, -0.04 on VQA-RAD), the highest-value next step is the Path-A HF smoke on VQA-RAD/SLAKE/MedXpert to test whether ATTENTION-GUIDED pruning preserves radiology lesion tokens better than uniform resolution-cap. Until then the -26% FLOP saving remains a PROJECTION, and G4 should be gated behind the per-benchmark radiology guardrail.
